All four ordered software criteria are now evidenced: source/fixture children, refreshed inputs and carry-forward software gates, one exact candidate 16 input set with full clean/upgrade/pair/visual/timing/protocol proof, and the approved cross-lab audit with all eight findings resolved. H700 builds, physical facts and release publication remain the separately ordered milestone route.

[Final audit record](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/7f293a22d97317d1632952a5cf2e9d4a45bd2cb2/docs/audits/2026_10_06-milestone-m7-p4-fixes-383/08-installed-resolution.md). Device testing and release publication retain their separate gates.
